settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What makes the MyoLift MD different from other microcurrent devices?
settings.text1: The MyoLift MD features 8 frequency-specific waveforms, designed to target different facial muscles and skin concerns. It also includes 8 preset treatment protocols and 9 customizable program slots, allowing practitioners to build personalized treatments based on client needs, time, and intensity preferences.
settings.title2: Who is the MyoLift MD designed for?
settings.text2: The MyoLift MD is a professional-grade device designed for licensed estheticians, medical spas, and skincare professionals. It is ideal for practices looking to offer advanced microcurrent lifting, muscle re-education, and facial contouring treatments.
settings.title3: How long does a typical MyoLift MD treatment take?
settings.text3: Treatment time depends on the protocol selected. Preset treatments vary in duration, and custom sessions can be programmed based on the practitioner’s preference. On average, a full facial treatment typically ranges from 30 to 60 minutes.
settings.text4: Yes. In addition to the 8 preset protocols, the device allows practitioners to create and store up to 9 custom treatment programs, adjusting waveform selection, intensity, and timing to fit specific client goals.
settings.text5:
Clients often experience:

  • Immediate lifting and contouring
  • Improved muscle tone
  • Enhanced facial symmetry
  • Smoother appearance of fine lines
  • Improved circulation and skin vitality

You may see results after one treatment, with cumulative improvements over a recommended treatment series.
settings.title6: Is the MyoLift MD safe for all skin types?
settings.text6: The MyoLift MD is safe for most skin types when used by a trained professional. However, it is not recommended for clients with pacemakers, uncontrolled epilepsy, pregnancy, or certain medical implants. A proper consultation should always be conducted prior to treatment.
settings.title7: How often should clients receive Myolift MD treatments for optimal results?
settings.text7:
For optimal lifting, toning, and skin rejuvenation results with the Myolift MD, we recommend beginning with a corrective series.

Most clients benefit from:

  • 1–2 treatments per week
  • For 4–8 weeks, depending on their skin condition, age, muscle tone, and desired outcome

Because the Myolift MD delivers true microcurrent with 8 frequency-specific waveforms and preset protocols, practitioners can tailor treatment intensity and duration to the client’s goals. A consistent series helps retrain facial muscles, improve ATP production, and support collagen and elastin synthesis.
